MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 6
   D. 7

2. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31.6
   C. 31
   D. 37

3. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 33

4. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 2

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/2
   D. 1/4

6. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 43
   D. 1

7. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

8. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 2

9. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 22
   C. 11
   D. 121

10. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 13
   D. 26

11. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 26
   D. 5

12. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 11
   C. 24
   D. 25

13. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 23.6
   D. 29

14. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 7
   D. 49

15. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

16. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

17. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

18. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 2
   D. 1

19. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 20
   C. 1
   D. 9

20. Solve for x: x + 3 = 9. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 9
   C. 6
   D. 3

21. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 20
   C. 30
   D. 75

22. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 7
   C. 5
   D. 1

23. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 90

24. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 3
   C. 11
   D. 28

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
